description.content: Submit a batch of OpenTelemetry spans. The body must be an `ExportTraceServiceRequest` encoded as JSON or Protobuf. The hosted collector strips the `highlight.project_id` resource attribute and routes the spans to the matching Highlight project.

Native OpenTelemetry Protocol (OTLP) HTTP/JSON ingestion endpoint for structured logs. Accepts standard `ExportLogsServiceRequest` payloads. Logs are stored in ClickHouse for sub-second full-text search and pattern detection in the Highlight dashboard.
